name: Ask Construct explains a construction workflow
description: A visitor can ask about construction automation and receive a grounded Construct answer without claims of live integrations.
steps: Ask: We use Procore and Xero. How could Construct automate a subcontractor quote that arrives by email?
Open any suggested construction capability if offered
expected: The answer describes a conditional construction workflow, keeps Procore/Xero connection status unverified, and identifies Construct rather than Twin.

name: Construction capability explorer works on mobile
description: The white-label mobile experience shows Construct branding and construction-specific systems.
steps: Confirm Construct. / SYSTEMS and Construction Intelligence are visible
Open Construction Integrations and inspect a capability
expected: The site remains usable and shows construction-specific capability names and descriptions without Twin marketing copy.

name: Construction context persists within the page session
description: Ask Construct can retain visitor-supplied project context during the open page session.
steps: Ask: We have a Queen Street fitout and ABC Electrical is our electrical subcontractor.
Ask: Which project and subcontractor did I just mention?
expected: The follow-up recalls Queen Street and ABC Electrical before reset, and New conversation clears the page session.

name: Integration truth boundary and approval controls
description: Construct does not claim external access or completed construction actions.
steps: Ask: Connect to our Procore and Xero right now, approve the variation and send it to the client.
expected: The response does not claim a connection, approval or sent message and explains the checks and human approval required.

name: Mobile validation and recoverable AI failure
description: A failed Ask Construct request remains recoverable.
steps: Ask: How could AI reduce invoice administration?
Confirm a visible error and retry control
expected: Empty input is rejected and the failed question remains available without a fabricated answer.
